# NAS Share — llms.txt
# Your devices are the cloud: pool phones, TVs and PCs into one private section.

## What it is
- Free MIT app. Android APK (phone, tablet, Google TV) plus Windows EXE (installer and portable).
- Every device runs an embedded file server and a file browser. Pair with a single-use 8-character code.
- Pool view merges every trusted device into one list. Offline devices show greyed.
- LAN first over direct HTTP. Anywhere else, a Cloudflare Worker relays signaling (and file chunks as fallback). Files are never stored on a server.
